title: Conversation Compaction Failure: Unexpected Error When Attempting to Reduce Context Length
body:
**Bug Description**
I restarted a conversation and then I asked the system to reneable a set of flags and work forward from what would be next for this effort and then I got the message:\
\
Context low · Run /compact to compact & continue\
\
So I asked it to /compact \
\
Then go this:\
Error: Error during compaction: Error: Conversation too long. Press esc to go up a few messages and try again.\
\
Not sure what to do from here, but I would not expect this type of response from asking the system to do a /compact .. expecially when the system asked me to do so.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: win32
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 1.0.65
- Feedback ID: 902f5297-5edb-49b1-91c1-cb1e8fff33d7
